hooks.name: evidence-log
hooks.description: When the agent stops, append one metadata record to docs/evidence/kiro-log/<session>.jsonl. Works from the repository root, a subdirectory, or the workspace root that contains the clone (Kiro Web). The surface defaults to web; export EVIDENCE_SURFACE=ide or cli locally to override it.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"; [ -f scripts/evidence-log.sh ] || for d in */; do [ -f "$d/scripts/evidence-log.sh" ] && cd "$d" && break; done; EVIDENCE_SURFACE="${EVIDENCE_SURFACE:-web}" bash scripts/evidence-log.sh agent-stop
